**Input:**

* `RDS_integrated_Seurat_scTfh23.rds` (01)
* `DoubletScanner_scTfh23.csv` (02)
* `DF_Manual Annotation.csv` – manual assignment of every cluster to a major cell type

**Output:** `RDS_integrated_Seurat_T_B.rds` – integrated object with `Doublets` and `Celltype` (T cells / B cells / …)

Next: `04_Tcell_annotation_analysis.Rmd`

# Setup

Conda environment: *Seurat_toolbox2*.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 4)
```

```{r libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
```

```{r paths}
project <- "scTfh23"
rdata   <- "../RData/"
results <- "../results/"

color_vector_samples <- c(
  "Day0" = "#fdb863",
  "Day2" = "#e66101",
  "Day4" = "#b2abd2",
  "Day6" = "#54009E")
```

# Load data and add doublet calls

```{r load}
seurat.integrated <- readRDS(file = paste0(rdata, "RDS_integrated_Seurat_", project, ".rds"))

doublet_info <- read.csv(file = paste0(rdata, "DoubletScanner_", project, ".csv"), row.names = 1)
seurat.integrated$Doublets <- factor(doublet_info[rownames(seurat.integrated@meta.data), "scDblFinder.class"])
table(seurat.integrated$Doublets)
```

# Clustering and UMAP

Scaling (RNA: all genes; integrated assay), PCA (30 PCs), Louvain clustering (resolution 1), UMAP.
Doublets are kept here and removed in the T-cell analysis (04).

```{r clustering}
DefaultAssay(seurat.integrated) <- "RNA"
seurat.integrated <- ScaleData(seurat.integrated, features = rownames(seurat.integrated))

DefaultAssay(seurat.integrated) <- "integrated"
seurat.integrated <- ScaleData(seurat.integrated, verbose = FALSE)
seurat.integrated <- RunPCA(seurat.integrated, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
seurat.integrated <- FindNeighbors(seurat.integrated, dims = 1:30)
seurat.integrated <- FindClusters(seurat.integrated, resolution = 1)
seurat.integrated <- RunUMAP(seurat.integrated, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
```

```{r plot-doublets, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Doublets and singlets (scDblFinder)."}
DimPlot(seurat.integrated, reduction = "umap", group.by = "Doublets") + ggtitle("Cells colored by Doublets")
```

```{r plot-umap, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "UMAP of integrated samples. (A) Sample. (B) Louvain clusters."}
seurat.integrated$seurat_clusters <- factor(
  seurat.integrated$seurat_clusters,
  levels = 0:(length(unique(seurat.integrated$seurat_clusters)) - 1))

p1 <- DimPlot(seurat.integrated, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", cols = color_vector_samples) +
  ggtitle("Cells colored by sample")
p2 <- DimPlot(seurat.integrated, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, group.by = "integrated_snn_res.1") +
  ggtitle("Cells colored by clusters")
cowplot::plot_grid(p1, p2, labels = c("A", "B"))

table(seurat.integrated$orig.ident)
```

# Annotation of T and B cells

T- and B-cell marker expression per cluster; clusters were assigned manually (`DF_Manual Annotation.csv`).

```{r marker-dotplot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6, fig.cap = "T- and B-cell markers per cluster."}
DefaultAssay(seurat.integrated) <- "RNA"
DotPlot(seurat.integrated,
        features = c("Cd4", "Cd3d", "Cd3g", "Ltb", "Cd3e", "Cd79a", "Cd79b", "Cd74", "Mef2c"),
        group.by = "integrated_snn_res.1", assay = "RNA") +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0, space = "Lab", na.value = "grey50") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))
```

```{r annotation, fig.cap = "UMAP colored by major cell type."}
annotation_df <- read.table(paste0(results, "DF_Manual Annotation.csv"), sep = ";", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
datatable(annotation_df)

Idents(seurat.integrated) <- "seurat_clusters"
new.cluster.ids <- annotation_df$Celltype
names(new.cluster.ids) <- levels(seurat.integrated)
seurat.integrated <- RenameIdents(seurat.integrated, new.cluster.ids)
seurat.integrated <- AddMetaData(seurat.integrated, metadata = Idents(seurat.integrated), col.name = "Celltype")

DimPlot(seurat.integrated, reduction = "umap", label = FALSE, pt.size = 0.5, group.by = "Celltype")
table(seurat.integrated$Celltype)
```

# Save

```{r save}
saveRDS(seurat.integrated, file = paste0(rdata, "RDS_integrated_Seurat_T_B.rds"))
```

sessionInfo()
